recognize_zh: Ki-67 染色在真皮淋巴浸潤中呈斑駁分布：數個邊界不清的高增生群聚（被腫瘤殘食的反應性濾泡中心），周圍則為低增生的小淋巴細胞；不可把這些熱點誤判為大 B 細胞轉化。
features: Heterogeneous, mottled Ki-67 nuclear staining within a dermal lymphoid infiltrate
Several discrete clusters of densely Ki-67-positive nuclei corresponding to colonized/overrun germinal centers
Low proliferation index in the surrounding interfollicular small lymphoid cells
Dermal collagen with sparse positive cells at left
describe_en: Ki-67 immunostain of the dermal lymphoid infiltrate shows a mottled pattern of proliferation. Discrete clusters of densely positive nuclei correspond to reactive follicular structures that are overrun by the neoplastic B-cell infiltrate, while the surrounding interfollicular population shows a low proliferation index. The high-proliferation foci follow a follicular distribution and should not be interpreted as large B-cell transformation in the absence of sheets of large cells on H&E. Findings are consistent with the proliferation pattern of primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / large cell transformation
ddx.vs: Transformation shows diffuse sheets of large cells with a uniformly high Ki-67 index, rather than discrete follicle-shaped hot spots in a low-proliferation background.
PCFCL follicles lack polarization and often have a relatively low Ki-67 index in neoplastic follicles, whereas colonized reactive germinal centers here remain highly proliferative.
Reactive germinal centers are also Ki-67 high but are well formed with polarized zonation and surrounded by polytypic B cells without light-chain restriction.
